name: Análisis de Transición de Markov
description: Analiza inter-pixel transition probabilities using Markov chain models. AI images show different transition patrones compared to natural photographs.
algorithm: First-order Markov Chain + Transition Matrix Analysis
mechanism: Builds transition probability matrix from adjacent pixel differences. Entropy and transition patrones differ entre AI and real images.
parameters: States: quantized gradiente levels, Direction: horizontal
useCase: Analyzing pixel transition patrones for AI detección

references.title: Shi, Y.Q. et al. (2006). A Markov Process Based Approach to Effective Attacking JPEG Steganography. IHMSP.
Sullivan, K. et al. (2006). Steganalysis with Image Quality Metrics. IEEE TIFS.
Fridrich, J. (2009). Steganography in Digital Media. Cambridge University Press.

strengths:
• Captures pixel transition dependencies effectively
• Models natural image statistics rigorously
• Sensitive to subtle smoothing and processing
• Works in both spatial and transform domains
• Proven effective in steganálisis research
limitations:
• Transition matrix can be large and sparse
• Limited to first-order dependencies in basic form
• Quantization of valores de píxel affects precision
• Computacionalmente costoso for dense matrices
• Some AI models produce natural transition patrones
